injuries.name: Chris Youngblood
injuries.detail: Youngblood (foot) is out for Friday's game against Sacramento.

injuries.name: Vit Krejci
injuries.detail: Krejci underwent surgery on his fractured left ankle Wednesday and will be re-evaluated in eight weeks, Brett Siegel of ClutchPoints.com reports.

injuries.name: Ja Morant
injuries.detail: Head coach Micah Nori said Morant met with a doctor in Los Angeles, who gave him a positive outlook on his recovery from the hamstring injury. While Nori declined to update Morant's timetable, he added Morant "may not be out for as long as we thought," Trail Blazers Insider Sean Highkin reports.

injuries.name: Shaedon Sharpe
injuries.detail: Sharpe suffered a torn meniscus in his knee and is expected to miss six months, per Shams Charania of ESPN.

reasoning: On the season so far the Timberwolves are the stronger team; with home court the Timberwolves start about 5 points better, in a game of about 228 points.
Rest, travel and who is missing tilt it about 0 points towards the Timberwolves.
There are psychological storylines, but history says they are worth little here.
Bottom line: the Timberwolves win 65 times in 100, by about 5; most games like this end between 202 and 250 total points.
